# AUSVAPE CO

> Australia's premium vapour retailer — authentic disposables, devices and pods, dispatched same day from Melbourne. Strictly 18+.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured ranges, signature banner and FAQs.
- [Shop](/shop): The full catalogue with category, price and sort filters.
- [Disposables](/category/disposables): Pocket-ready disposable vapes.
- [Devices](/category/devices): Refillable devices and mods.
- [Accessories](/category/accessories): Replacement pods and add-ons.
- [About](/about): The AUSVAPE CO story and sourcing standards.
- [Journal](/blog): Notes on craft, care and considered vapour.
- [Contact](/contact): Email, WhatsApp and the Melbourne counter.
